title: View the patient's account
summary: Finance: quotes, invoiced treatments, payments and balance; print the summary or the account statement.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Period and currency
steps.details: Filter by period, search for a document and choose the currency.

steps.title: Account ledger
steps.details: Each quote, treatment and payment with its balance. Tap a row to invoice it, charge it, print it or send it.

steps.title: Summary
steps.details: Invoiced, paid, debt and available balance.

steps.title: A quote
steps.details: Tap it to see its items, invoice it or charge it.
